reason: The idea is right: a pre-registered read table is bookkeeping only. It costs 0 slots, adds no mechanism and needs no R8/R1-R10 exemption. But the paste-ready text contains an error that breaks its own top-prior lever read, so it should not be pasted as written. (1) The S1 proof in (2)(a) cannot be met for the CI file under the table's own order (3). Our LB row's LastSubmissionDate is the MAX submit time over our SCORED files, not the submit time of the file that completed last. Proof: the e10_watch snapshots 20260926T1620Z/1701Z/2001Z and 20260927T0147Z show 2026-09-26 00:02:18 (#38). #38 completed at 06:54:06Z, but #37 (submitted 00:02:12) completed later, at 07:34:12Z (ledger.md). Table (3) submits CI first (00:05Z), yet CI completes last (~09:40-10:45Z), after SEC (00:10Z) and DIV (00:45Z) have scored. From then on our row shows 00:45 and never 00:05. So no S1 exists for the CI ref, and a 0.954 CI display, ~20-25% of its outcome mass, can be coded neither N4 nor U4. W2 has the same defect by design: file 2 (without CI, submitted after 12:00Z) completes ~2 h before file 1 (the CI stack, ~11:30Z). (2) The W2 file-2 rule ('>= 2 levers + and CI is one of them') produces a DUPLICATE whenever exactly two levers are +: exp76f minus CI = exp76d, exp76i minus CI = exp76e, exp76h minus CI = exp76g, all already scored in W1. The file is only new when all three levers are +. (3) Three open round-19 plan-check issues are left out: PC19-02 (no row for 46 still PENDING at the 23:45Z cutoff; at the 18:04:40Z header 46 is at L > 3.46 h), PC19-05 (the CI insertion gate is read on CI_hi, which is anti-conservative; item (8) repeats it) and PC19-08 (ladder_watch.py hardcodes its refs and base count, so 'watcher from 06:30Z' cannot run as written). (4) Item (8) turns card (2) 'CI >= 0.955 = info only, finals option only on the user's re-tick after the caveat' into a proposal {V_pub, #37}, but the text claims only two AMENDs. Value: private gain ~0 by design (the table's own odds). Its only value is avoiding misreads, and defect (1) creates one.
fix: Before pasting (ideally before 45 completes, ~18:35-19:00Z), change four places. (a) Replace the (2)(a) S1 proof. S0 = the newest download whose our-row SubmissionCount = n (the count before this ref). S1 = the first download after this ref's terminal poll header with count = n+1, where no other ref of ours turned terminal between S0 and S1. If another did (count jumps by >= 2), the lower display is MASKED, and equal displays are both MASKED. LastSubmissionDate is logged only as a cross-check: it equals the ref's submit time only when that ref is our newest-submitted scored file. Alternative with no counter: put CI LAST in W1 (SEC 00:05Z, DIV 00:40Z, CI 00:45Z). Submit order then equals completion order, CI completes at ~10:35-11:15Z, and W2 file 1 moves to ~11:45Z. (b) W2 file 2 only if ALL THREE levers are + (file 2 = exp76j in row B; in row A none, since exp76g+DIV = the base). Otherwise no file 2. (c) Add the PC19-02 row: 46 not terminal at the last header before 23:50Z means W1 = 45's row alone, and exp76c/g/exp73m move to W2. Adopt the PC19-05 CI gate: subtract CI_lo = 2.2 h, so 'did NOT fire' holds iff L_hi <= 10.2 h, else 'v'. Replace 'watcher from 06:30Z' with manual LB downloads at each terminal header (PC19-08). (d) Mark (8)'s CI proposal wording as AMEND R18-A1 (2), or keep the card's 'info + caveat; option only on re-tick'. Everything else (codes, BLIND k, lever states, 30-min stagger, max-stack table, T_last formula, N1 post-deadline, finals partner #37, private-read list) can stay as written.
realistic_gain: 0 on private and ~0 on public by itself (the table is pure bookkeeping). Its value is preventing misreads. With fix (a), a 0.954 CI read, ~20-25% of CI outcomes and ~0.2 of the top lever's mass, becomes codeable, which keeps the W2 stack logic intact. With fix (b), one duplicate W2 file is avoided in the 2-lever cases (the P(CI+ and SEC+) ~0.1 row plus the CI+DIV row). The table does not change team odds (P(>= 0.955) ~0.35-0.45 per the round-18 judge).
